Atlantic Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 200 AM EDT Tue Oct 20 2026
Regardless of the status of the system, high winds, coastal
flooding, and dangerous surf are expected along portions of the U.S. East Coast during the next few days. For more information, please consult statements and warnings from local National Weather Service offices and the Weather Prediction Center, along with High Seas Forecasts and Storm Warnings issued by the National Weather Service.

E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 1100 PM PDT Mon Oct 19 2026
South of Southern Mexico (EP94):
Satellite images indicate that the circulation of a low pressure system located a few hundred miles south of the Gulf of Tehuantepec is becoming better defined. The associated showers and thunderstorms are also beginning to show signs of organization, and a tropical depression is forecast to form during the next day or so. This system is expected to move westward to west-northwestward at around 10 mph during the next few days, remaining well offshore of southern Mexico.
